Black folks are about to be stripped of power in the South and this is the bullshit @amandalitman chooses to focus on. This will be the biggest destruction since Reconstruction.


Amanda Litman (@amandalitman)

If Democratic House members allow this to happen, the likely effect will be a majority that will not do what they’ve been elected to do — this is a generation of leaders who (by and large) are not willing to do things differently.





— https://nitter.net/amandalitman/status/205021223865

Cc @ScottJenningsKY


Joe Walsh (@WalshFreedom)

Yes, @ScottJenningsKY is super thin-skinned (he won’t see this post bcuz he blocked me on Twitter), so not a surprise he lost his shit last night. But here’s the thing about him. He doesn’t believe what he’s saying. He’s an actor playing a role. He found out he’d make big, big money by playing the big MAGA tough guy. So that’s what he’s doing. And @CNN pays him big bucks to play that role. And when you don’t really believe what you’re saying, when

Self-hating Black man.


CJ Pearson (@Cjpearson)

I’m a lifelong Georgian. 

There is no justifiable reason for every other state in the South to be making moves to redraw their maps while we sit on our hands. 

It is EMBARRASSING.



— https://nitter.net/Cjpearson/status/2050250687204717046#m
